description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called LayoutChangesActivity, demonstrating the use of automatic layout transitions within a ViewGroup, particularly adding and removing list items with animated effects.

classes.name: LayoutChangesActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates automatic layout transitions when adding or removing views dynamically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and references the container view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigation to parent activity and adding list items.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Creates a new list item view, sets text to a random country, sets up delete button logic, and adds it to the container with animated transition.
